image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), standing on a gravelly ground. The bird exhibits non-breeding or female plumage characteristics: brownish-grey upperparts with black and white wing markings, an orange-rufous breast, and a speckled head. It has a short, conical bill that is yellow-orange at the base and dark at the tip. The legs are pinkish-brown.

This is more severe than minor noise, indicating a structural failure in rendering fine ground details.
The background bokeh is uniform and painterly. While common in AI, it lacks the complex depth transitions of a real lens, but is less critical than the foreground texture issues.
